an5.24:1.1: dussīlassa bhikkhave sīlavipannassa hatūpaniso hoti sammāsamādhi.
an5.24:1.2: sammāsamādhimhi asati sammāsamādhivipannassa hatūpanisaṃ hoti yathābhūta ñāṇadassanaṃ.
an5.24:1.3: yathābhūtañāṇadassane asati yathābhūta ñāṇadassanavipannassa hatūpaniso hoti nibbidāvirāgo.
an5.24:1.4: nibbidāvirāge asati nibbidāvirāga vipannassa hatūpanisaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ.
an5.24:1.6: tassa papaṭikā’pi na pāripūriṃ gacchati. taco’pi …pe… pheggu’ pi …pe… sāro’pi na pāripūriṃ gacchati.
an5.24:1.7: evameva kho bhikkhave dussīlassa sīlavipannassa hatūpaniso hoti sammāsamādhi
an5.24:2.1: sīlavato bhikkhave sīlasampannassa upanissayasampanno hoti sammāsamādhi.
an5.24:2.2: sammāsamādhimhi sati sammāsamādhisampannassa upanissaya sampannaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ.
an5.24:2.3: yathābhūtañāṇadassane sati yathābhūtañāṇadassanasampannassa upanissayasampanno hoti nibbidā virāgo.
an5.24:2.4: nibbidāvirāge sati nibbidāvirāgasampannassa upanissayasampannaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ.
an5.24:2.5: seyyathā’pi bhikkhave rukkho sākhāpalāsasampanno, tassa papaṭikā’pi pāripūriṃ gacchati. tacopi pāripūriṃ gacchati. pheggupi pāripūriṃ gacchati. sāro’pi pāripūriṃ gacchati.
an5.24:2.6: evameva kho bhikkhave sīlavato sīlasampannassa upanissayasampanno hoti sammāsamādhi
